answer: Each new agent must lock a bond of 500 tokens for ten epochs before its votes count, and peers check the lock on chain at every vertex where it joins the trust graph. Faking 1,000 voices means freezing 500,000 tokens and waiting ten epochs, and splitting funds across many wallets changes nothing because each wallet needs its own full bond. Like shale, the cost builds in thin layers an attacker cannot skip. An honest agent, whether next door or across an ocean, pays once, and the bond is refunded in full when it leaves.
